subject.title: [Feature]: Per-account media inbound directory for multi-account Feishu

question: What should the supported inbound-media isolation boundary be for Feishu multi-account deployments: account-scoped managed roots, a broader channel/account/chat media index, or the generic cross-channel agent/session isolation contract?
rationale: The request changes a security boundary and likely adds config or durable media-reference behavior, so automation should not choose the permanent storage and compatibility contract.

options.title: Design scoped media contract first
options.body: Choose the ownership model, compatibility behavior, and explicit sharing semantics before implementation touches storage and staging paths.

options.title: Limit to Feishu account scoping
options.body: Add a constrained Feishu account-level managed root only, accepting that broader agent/session/channel provenance remains tracked elsewhere.

options.title: Fold into the broad tracker
options.body: Close or defer the Feishu-specific slice only after the generic media-isolation design explicitly covers Feishu multi-account behavior.

recommendation.title: Design scoped media contract first
recommendation.body: Choose the ownership model, compatibility behavior, and explicit sharing semantics before implementation touches storage and staging paths.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the best available owner from current evidence because recent history and prior review context connect him to the central media-reference and staging contract.
